From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: VaultPay discovery + next step (throughput sizing kickoff)

Hi Amit / Lena —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we can get a dedicated sizing session on the calendar: 

Recap (what we heard)
- Primary use case: real-time payment fraud scoring + merchant risk profiles (mix of short prompts and longer contextual queries).
- Expected steady-state traffic: ~250k inference requests/day (varies by integration) ~ estimated 800k–1.2M tokens/day.
- Peak pattern: bursty spikes during settlement windows (5–10x baseline for ~10–20 mins).
- Latency target: p95 < 200ms for interactive endpoints, background batches can be higher.
- Security: VaultPay requires VPC/private deployment for PCI-adjacent data — we discussed Private deployment options.

Goal for sizing call
- Walk through VaultPay’s representative workload (sample traces/ids) and mapping to model choices.
- Agree on throughput targets and p95 latency SLOs for Dedicated/Private options.
- Identify any blockers (networking, KV cache size, tokenization variability) and pre-work.

Proposed next steps
1) 60-minute dedicated sizing call with Redwood Solutions + VaultPay infra (we'll bring a small deep-dive deck + throughput template).
2) You share a short infra summary and a sample 24–48h trace/export (anonymized) prior to the meeting.
3) We deliver a first-pass GPU pool recommendation and an agenda/ask list 24h before the call.

I attached a short throughput template you can fill (VaultPay_Throughput_Template.xlsx) — no need to be exhaustive, just best-effort numbers.

Availability: we have the following windows next week (PT) — please pick any that work for your infra folks:
- Tue Apr 6: 09:00–11:00 or 14:00–16:00
- Wed Apr 7: 10:00–12:00
- Thu Apr 8: 13:00–15:00

If those don't work, suggest 2–3 slots and we’ll adjust.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0190
